baseline_runtime_attribution: Accepted literal Sum/Avg binaries with their original source and build receipts.
change: Reuse completed Count/Min/Max descriptors beneath instant literal arithmetic or Boolean comparisons.
proof: Successful outputs are Float or empty and names are dropped. Existing root, literal, ordinary matrix selector, clock and descriptor guards establish unchanged identities. Transfer follows annotation merge; fold state is cleared and final evaluation remains fresh.
preserved: native Count membership and histogram-weighted statistics
native-only empty extrema and mixed extrema with surviving Float warnings
singleton/sparse identity, late provider errors before duplicates and cancellation cleanup
final reads including ignored native rows when another row survives
paged history on both axes, disabled implicit caps, public ABI and provider interfaces

qualification.original_engine: Prometheus v0.315.0 / pinned Go1.27.1 AMD64 FMA-on
qualification.original_capture_reuse: Captured once before the candidate; verified and reused unchanged after correcting two test expectations.
qualification.construction_error_scope: Default-profile anchored/smoothed requests are compared as errors, not executed resource cases.
qualification.causal_red: Old engine reads 48 samples instead of 32 in both extended Count arithmetic and Boolean tests.

plan.acceptance: Exact outputs and logical counts; all8memory peaks/current/allocation traffic nonincreasing. Target family/overall<=0.90, controls<=1.05, no individual persistent>1.05. Keep final fresh reads and causal cancellation/error checks.
plan.compiled_policy: Decision66 proportional absolute/relative/cumulative fixed costs, query memory separate.

resources.memory_observations: All measured current/peak/acquired/released fields nonincreasing; no overflow. Only workspace peak changes, with a maximum reduction of 8278 bytes.
resources.scope: Finite query-accounted measurements, not process RSS or live dbengine cache use; peaks are not additive. Histogram-weighted logical statistics are checked by causal units; C callers also check Float logical/read totals.

test_refinement.status: two test expectation failures; production candidate unchanged
findings: Native-only extrema avoids final reads only when the whole result is empty. A surviving Float row causes final selector traversal of the ignored native row too.
Empty descriptor admission and publication have zero counted loop work. Use an explicitly cancelled token for empty-list checks; work-triggered cancellation still tests populated scans.

limitations: Finite synthetic queries, not production-weighted, concurrent, live-provider or physical ARM throughput.
Only admitted instant one-operation literal roots are accelerated; general range, clock and dynamic/nested paths remain.
An entirely empty native-only extrema result avoids final reads; a surviving Float row retains ordinary final traversal of ignored native rows.
Empty descriptor paths perform no counted loop work; already-cancelled control tests cover them. Populated scans retain work-triggered interruption tests.
C results are inspected after query release while reports remain alive; these cases alone do not prove lifetime after report release.
Arithmetic unit helpers are not independent numerical oracles; complete expressions are compared with the fresh original Go captures.
